text: Yeah, hi, so here's the problem. I got a digital camera, but it doesn't zoom as far as I need. Like I said, I use it for bird-watching. I want to exchange it for one with the maximum zoom capacity. All the other specs need to be the same, though. I'm in San Antonio, 78260. And I want to use my PayPal for any extra payment. Can you help with this exchange as soon as possible?
zh: 是的，你好，所以问题是这样的。我买了一个数码相机，但它变焦范围不够我需要的。就像我说的，我用它观鸟。我想换一个变焦能力最强的。其他的规格需要相同。我在圣安东尼奥，78260。我想用我的PayPal支付任何额外费用。你能尽快帮我处理这个换货吗？
